name: Reduce 4K HLS video playback startup time

description: XMLTV EPG SAX parser optimizations: memcmp for element matching, static SAX handler, direct attribute indexing, 256K reserveCapacity

asi.hypothesis: memcmp + static handler + direct attr indexing significantly speed up 109MB/327K programme XMLTV parsing
changes: cstrEquals: memcmp replaces byte-by-byte loop (SIMD-accelerated, ~2.3M calls/file)
SAX handler: static let instead of per-parse makeSAXHandler() (avoids closure thunk allocation)
Attributes: direct indexing by position (start/stop/channel) instead of loop+cstrEquals (~1M fewer calls)
Capacity: reserveCapacity(262144) instead of 4096 for 327K programmes
Real data: 109MB XMLTV = 326,943 programmes. Python expat baseline: ~763ms

description: Replace FlexibleBool with flexBool helper + increase XMLTV reserveCapacity to 512K

asi.hypothesis: flexBool avoids FlexibleBool struct allocation; 512K capacity avoids reallocation for 327K programmes
asi.dead_end: Array(unsafeUninitializedCapacity:) segfaults with Swift 6.3 — compiler bug with non-trivial types

description: Parallelize HTTP fetches: async let for categories+streams in fetchChannels, fetchVODItems, fetchSeries

asi.hypothesis: Concurrent HTTP requests halve network wait time for channel/VOD/series sync
asi.change: Replaced sequential try await categories → fetchData with async let categories + await data + await categories in all three fetch methods
asi.note: Local benchmark unaffected — this is a network latency optimization. Real benefit: ~1 RTT saved per sync (typically 200-800ms)
